pack: Grade 1 Math: Counting, Reading, and Writing Numbers to 100

pages_detail.activities: Four counting tracks from 0, plus a by-10s continuation row to 100. First box on every track is the teal 0 start.
pages_detail.title: Count from 0

pages_detail.activities: Draw a line to match 6 words to numerals, then circle the word for 4 numerals, using word banks only. No child writes a number word from memory.
answers: A: twelve to 12, eighteen to 18, twenty to 20, thirty to 30, fifty to 50, ninety to 90
pages_detail.title: Words and Numerals

pages_detail.activities: Read a tens-and-ones description and write the numeral, then read a numeral and write its tens and ones, with a worked example for each section. Words only, no rods.
answers: A worked: 1 ten and 5 ones is 15
B worked: 30 is 3 tens and 0 ones
B: 12 is 1 ten and 2 ones; 16 is 1 ten and 6 ones; 60 is 6 tens and 0 ones; 80 is 8 tens and 0 ones
pages_detail.title: Tens and Ones in Words

pages_detail.activities: Count loose dots and write the numeral. Worked 12, then small groups, then tens-grouped groups for 34, 52, and 80. Dots only, groups of ten separated by spacing and colour, no rods, grids, or ten-frames.
pages_detail.title: Count the Objects
